Attached is our redlined Order Form based on last week's call. Key things we changed on the commercial side:
- Clarified invoice routing and remit entity (see Section 3.2) to align with Redwood Finance processes.
- Added a short appendix on tax withholding responsibility by jurisdiction (redline markup lines 88-102).
- Proposed Net 45 for standard customers; suggested Net 30 for first invoice on pilot (see payment terms table).

Actions we need from you to finalize:
1) Confirm which legal entity will accept invoices (Nimbus US vs. Nimbus EMEA).
2) Confirm whether Nimbus requires Redwood to accept a withholding deduction (and if so, provide the title of the relevant tax form).
3) If you accept the net terms as proposed, sign and return via DocuSign link (included).

Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice routing, net terms & escrow evidence request

Thanks Soojin — received. A few immediate questions from procurement and our legal counsel:

- Invoice remit: We typically require invoices to be issued to Nimbus Analytics, Inc. (US entity). Can Redwood confirm the billing entity and whether Redwood can receive PO copies addressed to Nimbus Analytics, Inc.?
- Net terms: Our standard is Net 60. For a pilot we'll consider Net 30 for the initial invoice but need finance approval. Can Redwood accept Net 60 on the master order if Net 30 is not approved?
- Escrow / evidence request: Our security team wants an evidentiary note in the Order Form that Redwood will provide invoice-level logs (for audit) and a single PDF with evidence for tax withholding when requested. Can you indicate where in your redline that lives?
- Wiring: we'll need sample wiring instructions to share with our AP team (bank name, account name, account number, SWIFT/IBAN). Can you provide a sanitized sample (we'll confirm on DocuSign sign-off)?

Also looping in Markus from Legal — Markus, any commercial redlines you want us to prioritize?

Thanks,
Alyssa
Director, Procurement | Nimbus Analytics
alyssa.chen@nimbusanalytics.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice routing, net terms & escrow evidence request

Thanks Alyssa — looping in Kimberly (Finance) and Karthik (Legal) to address the items. Quick answers here:

- Billing entity: Redwood will invoice Redwood, Inc. (US). We've added explicit remit instructions in Section 3.2 and included a sample wiring instruction file for your AP. If Nimbus needs invoices addressed to Nimbus Analytics, Inc., we can include PO references and ship invoices to the address you provide (please confirm).
- Net terms: We can accept Net 60 for the MSA as-is but would request Net 45 as standard. For the pilot we are OK to make the first invoice Net 30 as a one-off if your finance team approves.
- Escrow / evidence: We added a short clause requiring Redwood to provide invoice-level logs on request for audit (see Appendix B, redline markup). We can also provide a PDF bundle of withholding evidence if a deduction is applied — Finance will confirm process.

Attaching: [Attachment: wiring_instructions_sample.csv (CSV, 1 page)]

Kimberly / Karthik — can you weigh in on the withholding evidence flow and whether the wording in Appendix B is sufficient for Nimbus to rely on? If not, please propose alternate language.

Soojin

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@nimbusanalytics.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice routing, net terms & escrow evidence request

Hi Alyssa / Soojin —

Thanks for the context. A couple of clarifying points from Finance:

1) Withholding: If Nimbus withholds tax at source, Redwood requires written evidence (withholding certificate or tax authority receipt) before Redwood recognizes the withheld amount as final. We added language to Appendix B that allows Redwood to issue a credit note if withholding evidence is provided within 90 days of invoice date.

2) Invoice remit & PO: Redwood can accept PO references that specify Nimbus Analytics, Inc. as the bill-to; however, the legal entity to which we send funds will remain Redwood, Inc. Please have your AP include the PO number on the invoice (we will route to the bill-to you specify for matching).

3) Wiring: attached is a sanitized sample. For final wiring instructions we'll exchange via secure channel (we do not put full account numbers in the Order Form).

Recommended next steps:
- If Nimbus agrees to the revised Appendix B language, please confirm by reply and we will issue an updated DocuSign packet.
- If you need the 90-day window shortened, let us know and we can propose a trade (shorter window in exchange for Net 60 on the MSA).

Attachments: [Attachment: wiring_instructions_sample.csv (CSV, 1 page)]

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Thanks — this looks good from our side. A couple of quick confirmations:

- Nimbus confirms the bill-to will be Nimbus Analytics, Inc. (US) and AP will include a PO on invoices.
- Legal is comfortable with Appendix B as amended (90-day evidence window) provided Redwood accepts Net 60 on the MSA. We can agree to the Net 45 concession for commercial flexibility, but need Net 60 as the default payment term in the master order.

If Redwood signs off on Net 60 default (with the one-off Net 30 first-invoice concession noted), we can proceed to DocuSign and run the PO through AP next week.

On behalf of Nimbus — please send the final DocuSign packet and we will have it executed.
